purpose: Phase-0 tooling + licensing smoke for the AA applicability-model project (spec section 3.1). Records exact versions, licenses, and a deterministic invocation smoke for the profile-HMM engine (pyhmmer) and the antibody-numbering comparator (ANARCII).

pyhmmer.role: profile-HMM engine for the competitive profile bank (production candidate path)
pyhmmer.bundled_hmmer: HMMER 3.x bundled in the pyhmmer 0.12 series (exact engine string to be pinned in the requirements lock; pyhmmer statically vendors HMMER, so no system HMMER on PATH is required)
pyhmmer.license: MIT AND BSD-3-Clause AND BSD-2-Clause (fully permissive; no redistribution blocker for the tooling itself)

deterministic_smoke.procedure: build_msa on a 4-sequence IGHV-FR1-like MSA -> Pipeline.search_hmm over {homologous VH query, light-chain FR1 query}, run twice

anarcii.role: external antibody-numbering comparator/teacher (spec 3.1: NOT auto-admitted to production; a production dependency would require its own size/license/latency/reproducibility decision)
anarcii.runtime_note: language-model-based; downloads model weights on first inference (network). torch already present.

numbering_smoke.constructor: (seq_type='antibody', mode='accuracy', batch_size=32, cpu=False, ncpu=-1, verbose=False, max_seqs_len=102400, low_score_warn=False, return_logits=False)

redistribution_gate_status.profile_bank_reference_data: OPEN — the HARD gate per spec 3.1 is the REDISTRIBUTION terms of the germline/reference source used to BUILD the profiles (e.g. IMGT terms are restrictive). This is unresolved at the tooling stage and must be settled in the fresh-cohort/profile census before any profile bank can enter a PUBLIC .alignair bundle. Valid resolutions: redistributable reference inputs / explicit permission / documented user-side hydration / STOP the production-profile candidate.

wheel_hash_pinning: TODO in the implementation plan: pin pyhmmer==0.12.1 and anarcii==2.0.8 with sha256 wheel hashes in a hashed requirements lock; record the exact bundled HMMER engine version string.
